name: YITAMOTOR 74" Hydraulic Skid Steer Dozer Blade, Universal Skid Steer Attachment, Adjustable, Hydraulic Dozer Blade with Spring Shocks for Efficient Debris and Snow Management
fitment: Our skid steer accessories feature a superior design that enables a universal skid steer connection; This allows compatibility with almost all skid steers, loaders, and tractors, such as Ford 8n, 9n, Kubota, BX, or Kioti tractors

description:
The YITAMOTOR dozer skid steer attachment offers side-to-side adjustability. Utilizing your tractor's hydraulics, you can set the blade to the perfect angle; The individual adjustment of the two dozer plates allows for precise control over debris, dirt, and snow
Fitment
Our skid steer accessories feature a superior design that enables a universal skid steer connection; This allows compatibility with almost all skid steers, loaders, and tractors, such as Ford 8n, 9n, Kubota, BX, or Kioti tractors
Features
Adjustable Angles: The YITAMOTOR dozer skid steer attachment offers side-to-side adjustability. Utilizing your tractor's hydraulics, you can set the blade to the perfect angle; The individual adjustment of the two dozer plates allows for precise control over debris, dirt, and snow
Universal Skid Steer Connection: Our skid steer accessories feature a superior design that enables a universal skid steer connection; This allows compatibility with almost all skid steers, loaders, and tractors, such as Ford 8n, 9n, Kubota, BX, or Kioti tractors
Spring Shock Absorbers: The 79" Hydraulic Dozer Blade includes heavy-duty spring shocks; These spring shocks absorb impacts, reducing friction on the bottom plate, extending your blade's life, and maximizing efficiency; It is an ideal tractor snow blade
Hydraulic Rotation: The blade's hydraulic rotation allows for easy angle adjustments without leaving your seat; This feature enables you to set the blade's angle effortlessly and start pushing dirt and snow with our skid steer dozer attachment
Dimensions & Durability: Our dozer blade measures 73.6" W x 32.5" H x 27.8" D; The cutting edge ensure durability and longevity; YITAMOTOR's dozer skid steer attachment is a reliable choice for your tractor
